notes.title: More sex, more fun
notes.content:
Thanks to everybody who report me the bugs in the game and give the ideas about new functions and improvements!
I have made by your requests:

Improvements:
+ Rebuild of open doors triggers
+ Fix of opening multiple panels at once
+ Optimization: minus 4Gb game size

Game play functions:
+ Undress button
+ On/Off x2 UI size
+ Sex variants for main character (Now only for female. For male I will create animations a little later)
+ Animation speed slider for sex variants
+ Hot keys for sex variants
1...0 - Sex variants changer
+- - animation speed
